content:
maria: Heads up — Bridge St LLM Fair is confirmed for May 22-23. We have a 10x10 island. Need final plan: booth ops, swag order, speaking submission status, launch post copy, and lead routing. Who can own which piece?

jamie: I can own speaker submission + demo script. Submitted talk (awaiting review) — title: "Serving LLMs at Product Scale". Need a 1-paragraph abstract and headshot by EOD Friday.

sophia_ops: I’ll take booth ops & shipping. Questions: crate dimensions? power needs? will we need a table cloth + 2 rollups?

maria: crate = 2x 24x24x40, weight ~120lbs each. Yes to tablecloth + 2 rollups. We also requested power drop (1x 110v).

sam_growth: I’ll handle lead routing + QR / post-event followups. Plan: QR -> short form -> HubSpot + tag 'bridge_st_2025'. Need copy for the short form and the success redirect.

eli_design: I’ll run booth visuals and social assets. Two quick asks: logo vector, new banner CTA line. Also need tee mockups for approval.

jamie: For the talk, draft abstract: "How Redwood Inference scales LLM inference reliably across hosted and private deployments — tradeoffs, routing strategies, and cost controls." Will drop a first pass in the thread in 30m.

sophia_ops: Swag recs from last year: stickers 500, tees 200 (S-XL), hoodies 40, demo postcards 300, pens 150. Budget ok? Also need vendor lead time — 2 weeks for tees, 1 week for stickers.

maria: budget approved up to $6k. Prioritize tees + stickers + 2 banners + table runner. Hoodies only if remaining budget.

sam_growth: Routing details: QR on table -> short form (email, company, role, interest checkbox). Quick mapping to HubSpot via Zapier. Proposed filter: if interest contains 'pilot' or role contains 'platform' -> create task in Sales queue; else goes to MQL nurture.

sam_growth: Zapier payload (example):
```
POST https://hooks.redwood-internal.com/bridge-leads
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "role": "{{role}}",
  "interest": "{{interest}}",
  "source": "bridge_st_2025"
}
```

eli_design: For socials, recommend 3 posts: 1) Pre-event announcement (2w out) 2) Speaker highlight (1w out) 3) Day-of demo invite (morning of). Captions + CTAs in a doc — will upload.

maria: Can we also run a short webinar the week after for captured leads? 30-minute demo + AMA. sam, you good to run the follow-up cadence?

sam_growth: Yep — proposed cadence: Day0 thank-you email, Day3 webinar invite, Day10 product deep-dive, Day21 case-study nurture. Segment by tag 'interested_pilot' for SDR outreach.

sophia_ops: Shipping update: booked freight with FastShip. Pickup May 18, ETA venue May 20. Tracking: https://fastship/CHK12345. Crates labeled REDWOOD_01/02. Contact on-site: Aaron (venue ops) +1-555-0199.

eli_design: Mockups uploaded: /assets/bridge-st/ — table runner, two banner sizes, sticker sheet, tee mock. Need final logo approval from Maria.

maria: Approved except shrink the tagline and increase CTA font. Eli, update and resend.

jamie: Speaker materials: slides due May 8. Also want 3 demo scripts: live demo (3-5 min), fallback video, and 2-minute elevator pitch. I'll draft and post for review tomorrow.

sam_growth: Quick note on QR placement: put one QR on the table, one on the banner, and a shortlink on postcards. For attribution, use ?src=bridge_table / ?src=bridge_banner.

sophia_ops: Catering: venue allowed only pre-packaged snacks. Do we want water + protein bars? Budget $150.

maria: ok to buy water + bars. Volunteers: Jamie, Eli, Sophia (shift signup later).

logistics-bot: [shipment-scheduled] Pickup confirmed 2025-05-18 09:00 PDT. Carrier: FastShip. ETA venue 2025-05-20 14:30 PDT.

sam_growth: For lead scoring, add +30 if 'pilot' checkbox checked, +10 if role contains 'engineer' or 'platform'. Tag records that score >= 40 for SDR follow-up. I'll share the Zapier filter rules.

eli_design: Also thinking a small interactive: quick local latency benchmark on a laptop (30s). Need to confirm network access allowed at booth. Sophia, can you ask venue IT?

sophia_ops: On it — emailing Aaron now.

maria: To summarize owners: jamie = talk + demos; sophia_ops = booth ops + shipping + venue; eli_design = assets + mockups; sam_growth = lead routing + post-event cadence. Deadlines: speaker abstract + headshot by EOD Fri, slides May 8, swag order May 1, tees mock sign-off Apr 28.

jamie: noted. Will ping if any blocker.

eli_design: I'll post final assets + schedule for social copy by Apr 30.

maria: thanks all — I'll schedule a quick 20m sync next Tue to confirm everything. :rocket:
